transfer.title: Confirm the request to take over this home's service?
transfer.description:
«{company}» has asked Hauflo support to hand this home's service over to it.

If you own this home and asked for it, choose «Yes»: your confirmation is attached to the request. Nothing changes now: Hauflo support decides after telling the previous company (usually in 14 days). If the request is granted, «{company}» gets the home's setup in Hauflo and becomes the contact on the alarm cards; the previous company loses access.

Didn't ask for it? Choose «No».

independent.title: Make the house independent
independent.description:
What happens:
- The Hauflo dashboard cards are copied to /config/www/hauflo and added as dashboard resources, so the family's dashboard works without the agent.
- Every enabled Hauflo alarm rule becomes an ordinary automation in automations.yaml: the same sensors and alarm states, a push to the same Home Assistant app phones (critical where the rule is), a notification in HA and the rule's button. A backup copy of automations.yaml is made first. Automations made earlier this way are left as they are.
- Nothing is deleted. Hauflo keeps working until you remove the integration; until then an alarm comes twice.

What stops working once Hauflo is removed:
- Cloud monitoring: «agent offline», «KNX bus silent», the monitoring page and the service company's view.
- E-mail alarms and the alarm history in Hauflo; repeats until «Accept».
- Deploys and updates from the project, guest links, «Away» presence simulation, voice sentences, editing the family's automations and scenes on the dashboard (the ones already made keep running).

Submit to do it.

link_lost.title: No link to Hauflo for {hours} hours
link_lost.description: This Home Assistant has not reached Hauflo ({server}) for {hours} hours. The house works as before, but monitoring, alarms to Telegram and deploys from Hauflo wait for the link. Check the internet connection of this Home Assistant; the agent reconnects by itself. This message goes away when the link is back.

unlinked.title: Hauflo no longer knows this Home Assistant
unlinked.description: The project was unlinked or deleted in Hauflo, so the agent stopped connecting. To link it again, get a new code in Hauflo (project → «Connect the home» → «Get a code») and enter it in Settings → Devices & services → Hauflo → Re-configure. If you don't use Hauflo any more, delete the integration.

outdated.description: This agent is version {version}; Hauflo needs at least {minimum} (latest: {latest}). Deploys and some features may fail until it is updated: HACS → Hauflo → Update, then restart Home Assistant.

rule_fault.title: Value rule «{name}»: its sensor gives no data
rule_fault.description: The rule «{name}» watches {entity}, which gives no usable value now ({reason}). Hauflo doesn't act on an old value: the rule waits (a heater rule switches the heater off). Check the sensor and its connection; this goes by itself once the sensor answers. Hauflo assists — the installation's own protections stay in charge.

rule_rate.title: Value rule «{name}»: too many switches
rule_rate.description: {entity} was switched too often within an hour, so the rule «{name}» waits for the rest of the hour to spare the equipment. Usually the threshold is too close to the normal value: widen the margin (Y) or lengthen «for N minutes» in Hauflo.

rule_paused.title: Value rule «{name}» is paused
rule_paused.description: {entity} was changed by hand several times while the rule «{name}» held it, so the rule paused itself instead of arguing with people. Switch the rule on again (in Hauflo or with its switch in Home Assistant) once the reason is sorted.

no_backup_location.message: This Home Assistant has no local backup location, so the agent can't make a backup before a change.

rules_no_outdoor.message: No outdoor sensor and no weather forecast in Home Assistant.

rules_client_action.message: You can use: lights, blinds, a scene, «notify me».

rules_target_not_allowed.message: {entity}: Hauflo's devices only; never locks, the alarm, gates or opening a valve.

rules_bad_hysteresis.message: Margin Y: 0 or more and below the span (a contact has none).

rules_bad_range.message: The low value must be below the high one.

rules_limit_rules.message: At most {n} rules in a house.

rules_bad_back.message: Back to normal: reverse, nothing or own actions.

rules_bad_interlock.message: A supply fan interlock is for a heater rule only.

rules_loop.message: A loop: {entity} is both changed by the rule and decides it.

rules_conflict.message: {entity} ({attribute}) is already driven by the rule «{rule}».

rules_client_integrator_rule.message: The integrator's rule can only be switched on / off and its threshold moved.

rules_tune_not_allowed.message: The integrator doesn't let you change this threshold.

rules_toggle_not_allowed.message: The integrator doesn't let you switch this rule off.

rules_delete_not_allowed.message: Only your own rule can be deleted.

rules_bad_sources.message: Sources: {lo}–{hi} numeric sensors, no repeats, not another Hauflo value.

rules_explain_paused.message: Paused: the device was changed by hand several times. Switch the rule on again.

rules_explain_fault_wait.message: {label}: no data ({reason}) — the rule waits, nothing changed.

rules_explain_hold_manual.message: Manual — back at {time} or when {label} is back to normal.

rules_warn_interlock_off.message: «{name}»: the supply fan is off — the heater is switched off. Check the unit (a Hauflo hint, not a protection).

rules_warn_interlock_skip.message: «{name}»: the supply fan is off — the heater is not switched on. Check the unit (a Hauflo hint, not a protection).

rules_warn_rate.message: «{name}»: {entity} switched {n} times in an hour — the rule waits until {time} to spare the equipment.

rules_warn_paused.message: «{name}»: {entity} was changed by hand several times — the rule is paused. Switch it on again when sorted.

rules_hint_heater.message: Hauflo assists, it doesn't protect: check that the unit has its own heater overheat protection and fan run-on after switching off. Safety is the installation's job.

rules_hint_frost.message: A helper, not a protection: frost protection is the unit's own controls' job; Hauflo assists and tells you.

rules_hint_leak.message: Hauflo helps to shut the valve and tells you; the emergency protection is the installation's own.

rules_preview_fault.message: No sensor data now — the rule would wait.

rules_preview_waiting.message: «Only if» isn't met now — the rule wouldn't act.

rules_preview_wait.message: Now {value}, {threshold} — acts if it stays so for {minutes} min.

rules_preview_normal_for.message: Now {value} — normal; acts when {threshold} for {minutes} min.

rules_recipe_dew_point_airing.message: Drying ventilation by the dew point

rules_explain_deferred.message: {label} {value}, {threshold} · the device switches at {time}: a pause between switches (a Hauflo helper).

rules_explain_interlocked.message: {label} {value}, {threshold} · the heater stays off: the supply fan is off (a Hauflo helper). It comes on with the fan.

season_suggest_message.message: Looks like it's time for {to} — switch? {why}

season_suggest_why_heat.message: Outside, the daily average has been below {threshold}° for {days} days in a row.

season_suggest_why_cool.message: Outside, the daily average has been above {threshold}° for {days} days in a row.

rules_bad_window.message: Window: a statistic (mean / minimum / maximum / sum) and a period (hour / day / week).

rules_window_no_stats.message: {entity} has no statistics in Home Assistant (no state_class) — a value over a period can't be taken. Pick a sensor with statistics, or the value «now».

rules_window_stat_kind.message: {entity} ({kind}) can't give this statistic: mean / minimum / maximum are a measurement's, a sum is a counter's (total).

rules_window_on_time.message: {entity} is on / off: only «sum» (hours on in the period).

rules_window_history.message: This value is read from HA's history: the whole window must fit into {n} days.

rules_window_when.message: For a value over a period: below / above / outside / between.

rules_bad_outputs.message: The rule's outputs: on / off (suggestion, auto action).

rules_bad_quiet.message: Quiet hours: from and to as HH:MM, different from each other.

rules_explain_window_active.message: {label}, {stat}: {value} · in effect since {time}; back after {n} in a row {back}.

rules_explain_window_no_data.message: {label}: no data for {missing} of the last {n} ({stat}) — the rule waits and changes nothing.

rules_preview_window_no_data.message: Not enough statistics yet for the last {n} ({stat}) — the rule would wait.

rules_preview_window_now.message: {stat}: {value}; {held} in a row {threshold} — it would act now.

rules_preview_window_normal.message: {stat}: {value}; {held} of {n} in a row {threshold} — normal now.

rules_recipe_season.message: Winter / summer by the outdoor temperature

rules_recipe_heat_wave.message: Hot days: close the covers in the afternoon

rules_recipe_setpoint_unreached.message: A room doesn't reach its setpoint

rules_recipe_pump_runtime.message: A pump / boiler runs too long

rules_link_silent_sensor.message: Already in the rule hints on «Review»: a sensor that sends nothing for hours — per room and for the weather station. Not made twice here.
